# Flaus

> Flaus is the world's first eco-friendly electric flosser brand, combining sonic vibration technology with sustainable materials and circular economy practices.

Founded by Samantha Coxe, Flaus offers innovative electric flossing solutions designed to improve oral health while minimizing environmental impact. The brand emphasizes sustainability through recyclable refill heads, eco-conscious materials, and a comprehensive recycling program.

- Electric Flosser
